_comment: Canonical market-impact benchmark (progress-measurement surface). Runs each policy under {identity, piecewise_merit_order} across grid-scale batteries. Usage: python3 scripts/phase3_impact_eval.py --impact-config configs/impact_benchmark.json --checkpoint <dt.pt> --label <name>. Baselines (oracle, oracle_mi, fcas_rule, ppo) are included automatically.
